SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 2;
